CacheStorage

@webda/cache

Class: CacheStorage

Defined in: packages/cache/src/cache.ts:98

Storage for cached method results for a single instance.

Maintains an internal timestamp per entry to support TTL-based invalidation during reads and garbage collection.

Keys are method-level cache keys produced by methodKeyGenerator. Supports LRU eviction when maxSize is configured.
